milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate inside the sandstone building and get close to the orange bed (at spawn-relative (3, 0, 5)) while facing it. Max distance reduced to 5 blocks (from 16) per Validator/CommonSense feedback to ensure the player is actually inside the room and can see the bed, not just standing outside. Facing tolerance of 60° ensures the player is looking at the bed.

Uses inventory_has because mining smooth sandstone with a pickaxe drops the smooth_sandstone item into the player's inventory. The player has a diamond pickaxe and must mine at least 1 block from the solid east wall (at spawn-relative x=5) to access the crafting room. Smooth sandstone drops itself when mined with any pickaxe.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a diamond helmet results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player must retrieve 5 diamonds from the chest (at spawn-relative (8, 1, 6)) and use the crafting table (at spawn-relative (7, 1, 6)) to craft exactly 1 diamond helmet using the standard 5-diamond helmet recipe pattern.
